    Real Oviedo defeated Sevilla with a final score of
    1-0     in their La Liga match held on April 5, 2026. The crucial goal was scored by Federico Viñas for Real Oviedo. 
    Match Details 
    • Result: Real Oviedo 1 - 0 Sevilla
    • Date: April 5, 2026
    • Venue: Estadio Carlos Tartiere, Oviedo, Spain
    • Key Event: Tanguy Nianzou of Sevilla was shown a red card during the match. 
    League Impact 
    The loss kept Sevilla in 17th position, just two points above the relegation zone. Real Oviedo, despite the win, remained in 20th position.
